text.2:265: And the likeness of those who spend their wealth in search of Allah's pleasure, and for the strengthening of their souls, is as the likeness of a garden on a height. The rainstorm smiteth it and it bringeth forth its fruit twofold. And if the rainstorm smite it not, then the shower. Allah is Seer of what ye do.
text.23:50: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.
